items.title: News Corp (NASDAQ:NWSA) reports Q3 CY2026 in line with expectations
items.summary: Global media and publishing company News Corp (NASDAQ:NWSA) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027), with revenue up 6.4% year on year to $2.28 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.28 per share was 7.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Is News (NWSA) A Bargain On Its Q1 Fiscal 2027 Earnings Update?
items.summary: News (NWSA) heads into its Q1 fiscal 2027 earnings release and call on November 4, 2026, with investor attention on how its Dow Jones, digital real estate, and HarperCollins operations balanced recent sector pressures. Recent trading has been choppy for News, with the share price down 0.8% on the day and 1.7% over the past week. Despite this, the company is still showing a 2.7% 1 month share price return and a 12.5% year to date share price gain, contributing to a 15.1% 1 year total...
